newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to hold congress on child sex abuse.
newsitem.headline: Belgium to hold congress on child sex abuse.

text.p: Belgium will hold a four-day congress in May on the issue of sexual abuse of children, Justice Minister Stefaan De Clerck said on Tuesday.
"For four days, parents, children, Belgian and foreign experts will be able to reflect upon the problem of sexual violence on children," De Clerck said.
He was speaking during a visit by King Albert to the Central Bureau of Investigation of the Brussels Gendarmerie which has specialist groups probing child kidnapping and paedophilia.
Forty parents of missing and murdered Belgian children were among De Clerck's audience.

The issue of child sex abuse has gripped Belgium since last August when a major paedophile sex and murder scandal, dubbed the Dutroux case after chief suspect Marc Dutroux, erupted. Four young girls are known to have died at the hands of the Dutroux gang.
